text:
priya: quick sync — planning to flip precision flag on canary cluster tonight 23:00 PT to int4 for perf/cost signal. target: 10% traffic for 4h. need consensus on scope, monitors, and rollback criteria. flag: precision.swap.int4.canary :eyes:

priya: flag payload I'm going to push (draft):
```json
{
  "flag": "precision.swap.int4.canary",
  "audience": "canary-gpu-pool",
  "percent": 10,
  "duration_hours": 4,
  "fallback": "fp16",
  "monitoring": ["p99_latency", "error_rate", "quality_regression"]
}
```

samir: can we scope to model version and a couple routes only? don't want inference-heavy endpoints in canary. suggest add model_version: redwood-v1.2 and routes: [ /generate, /chat ]

alex: +1 to model & route filters. also propose thresholds: p99 latency increase >30ms OR error rate +0.5pp OR quality drop >1.5% absolute on our regression set -> immediate rollback. also set automated fallback to fp16 after 10m if errors spike.

maria: add a note to the rollout board and ping oncall. QA: run the quick manual eval after 30m and a fuller 50-prompt regression at 60m. tag: @samir for dashboard checks.

samir: @priya can you also include a nonzero warmup window? cold-kv-cache can skew first 10m. maybe start with 2m ramp then to 10%.

priya: good call — will do 2m linear ramp to 10%. updating the flag payload before push. will limit to redwood-v1.2 and routes /generate,/chat.

alex: quick check commands for oncall/QA:
```
# smoke: minimal request
curl -s -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/health/check -d '{"route":"/generate","model":"redwood-v1.2","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .status
\n# tail p99 spikes
kubectl logs -l app=inference-canary -f | grep p99
```

maria: added an entry to the rollout board (sheet row + ticket). tagging deploy lead.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: precision.swap.int4.canary -> start=2026-03-20T06:00:00Z, ramp=2m->10%, monitor=telemetry/p99,error,quality. notification channel=#eng-ml.

priya: ack deploy-bot. i'll post a kickoff message in #eng-ml when it starts and a quick summary after 30m. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

samir: I'll watch the canary dashboard at +30m and +60m. ping me if you want a live handoff.

alex: if anything looks off, flip flag to off and escalate. otherwise let's try to capture token-cost delta & p99 delta in the rollout notes.

priya: final: pushing at 23:00 PT, manual rollback allowed, automated fallback to fp16 on error spike. will update the ticket with exact flag JSON and links to dashboards. :rocket:
